LanguageData.RSMF.Announcement.Restaurant.Title: RimSMF:Restaurant is available now
LanguageData.RSMF.Announcement.Restaurant.Body: Turn your colony shop into a restaurant. Set menus and prices, assign cooks and servers, and welcome customers to order, dine and pay. Add a conveyor for self-service dining.\n\nThis official extension requires RimSimManagementFramework. Use the button below to open Steam Workshop and subscribe.
